walnut.$description: Walnut — Primary text color, filled action buttons, dark hero sections, footer wordmark. Deep warm brown that reads as near-black while carrying the brand's earthy warmth — used as both foreground and background surface

linen.$description: Linen — Page canvas, card surfaces, light text on dark backgrounds. Warm aged-cream that gives the entire system its paper-like, vintage quality

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary borders, muted helper text, subtle dividers. Neutral medium gray providing quiet separation without competing with the Walnut/Linen pair

espresso.$description: Espresso — Button text on light surfaces, alternate dark fill. Slightly lighter brown variant for typographic contrast within the dark family

onyx.$description: Onyx — Icon strokes, true-black accents on borders. Used sparingly where absolute contrast is needed

soft-sand.$description: Soft Sand — Alternate light surface, hover-state wash. Neutral off-white for slight tonal shifts away from the cream canvas

houseplant.$description: Custom display and body typeface used for all UI text — headlines at 30-70px with tight negative tracking, body at 16-20px, captions at 14px. The custom font carries geometric warmth that off-the-shelf alternatives cannot replicate

roboto.$description: Fallback body text — minimal usage, system-safe default

neuehelvetica55roman.$description: NeueHelvetica55Roman — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

gtstandard-m.$description: GTStandard-M — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
